human_editor_overrides.decision: compress the first two occurrences into 'warn and teach every person' while retaining the final 'present every person'
human_editor_overrides.rationale: English grammar distributes 'every person' naturally across both coordinated verbs; repeating it after both verbs is unnecessarily mechanical for FLT readability. Audit objections based solely on omission of the Greek threefold surface repetition are overruled.

verse_renderings.text: Right now I am glad to suffer for you. I am taking my turn to physically supply what is missing from Christ's sufferings, on behalf of His body, the church.
I became a servant of that church when God entrusted me with a task for your benefit: to bring you His message in full.
That message is the secret plan God kept hidden for ages and generations, but has now revealed to His holy people.
God wanted His people to know how dazzlingly rich this secret is among all the nations. The secret is this: Christ is in you, and He is your hope of sharing in His glory.
We preach Christ. With all wisdom, we warn and teach every person, so that we may present every person complete in Christ.
That is why I labor and compete, with the energy He powerfully works within me.

reader_notes.anchor: what is missing from Christ's sufferings
reader_notes.text: What is missing from Christ's sufferings does not mean His death on the cross was incomplete or not enough to save us. It refers to the ongoing hardships and persecution that the church (Christ's body) must continue to face in this world, which Paul is glad to take his share of.

In the Old Testament, God's special promises were mostly focused on the Jewish people. The 'secret' now revealed is that God has opened His family to everyone in the entire world (the Gentiles or all the nations) through Jesus.
